title: vehicle-sil GUI WebSocket server-to-client message (Protocol v4)
description: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for all 13 server-to-client WebSocket frames on `/ws` (Protocol v4). Behavioral invariants documented in `gui/protocol/README.md`: `hello.stream_seq` is the stream head; replayed log events carry `stream_seq <= hello.stream_seq`; live frames after `synced` have strictly increasing `stream_seq`; `values`, `dropped`, and `resync` never carry `stream_seq`; `hello.session` includes `variables` while `session` frames omit `variables`.
